2795416.name: Gen AI Assignment Part 1
2795416.description:
Part 1: Take the ChatGPT Edu training (3 points)--hopefully you've already done this!

 

ChatGPT Edu is a higher‑education–focused generative AI platform that offers an equitable, safer alternative to public AI platforms. You must complete the ChatGPT Edu training before our in-class AI skills development. The training should take you about 30 minutes to complete. Upload a screenshot of your email announcing your successful completion of the course in order to get 3 pts.

 

 

*****

 

Part 2: Using the AI Speech Coach for the “I'm an Advocate” Presentation (7 points)

In this activity, you’ll use a custom ChatGPT AI Speech Coach to support your development of the “I Am an Advocate” individual presentation. The coach is designed to guide you through the speech-preparation process, from exploring a meaningful topic to developing and organizing your ideas.

Why are we doing this?

Learning to use AI ethically and effectively is a skill that will serve you throughout your academic and professional career. This activity will help you:

  • Understand how to collaborate with AI as a brainstorming and coaching partner
  • Practice clear, purposeful prompting and thoughtful conversation with a generative AI tool
  • Use AI in an appropriate, ethical, and responsible way for academic work
  • Learn to evaluate and fact-check AI-generated suggestions rather than accepting them automatically
  • Maintain ownership of your ideas, arguments, and final presentation

The key principle: Effective AI use requires thoughtful human participation. The AI Speech Coach will ask questions, help you explore possibilities, and offer feedback, but you remain responsible for the ideas and choices in your speech.

How to Use the AI Speech Coach

Follow these steps for each new coaching session.

 

Step 1: Open the AI Speech Coach

Here's the AI Speech Coach linkLinks to an external site.. The link will open the custom GPT in ChatGPT. If prompted, sign in to your ChatGPT account.

 

Step 2: Start a New Conversation

Follow the opening instructions from the AI Speech Coach and respond to its questions. Treat the interaction as a conversation rather than simply asking the AI to generate a speech for you. The AI should help you develop your thinking, not replace it.

 

Step 3: Evaluate the AI’s Suggestions

As you work, critically evaluate what the coach recommends. Keep in mind you aren’t required to accept every suggestion! Hold on to ideas that strengthen your speech and reject ideas that do not fit your purpose. Revise anything that doesn't sound like you. 

You are also responsible for verifying any factual information, examples, statistics, quotations, or sources suggested by the AI.

Continue with the coaching conversation until you have clarified your topic, story or stories, purpose, main ideas, supporting evidence, and overall organization.

 

Step 4: Ask for a Consolidated Keyword Outline

When you have finished developing your ideas, ask the AI Speech Coach to create a consolidated outline based on the work you completed during the conversation.

You can use a prompt such as:

“Please create a consolidated keyword outline of the speech we developed in this conversation.”

Review the outline carefully before using it. Revise anything that does not accurately represent your ideas or intended message.

Submit the outline and your reflections about the process to Canvas.

2862419.name: AI Speech Coach
2862419.description:
Using the AI Speech Coach for the “I Am an Advocate” Presentation

In this in-class activity, you’ll use a custom ChatGPT AI Speech Coach to support your development of the “I Am an Advocate” individual presentation. The coach is designed to guide you through the speech-preparation process, from exploring a meaningful topic to developing and organizing your ideas.

Why are we doing this?

Learning to use AI ethically and effectively is a skill that will serve you throughout your academic and professional career. This activity will help you:

  • Understand how to collaborate with AI as a brainstorming and coaching partner
  • Practice clear, purposeful prompting and thoughtful conversation with a generative AI tool
  • Use AI in an appropriate, ethical, and responsible way for academic work
  • Learn to evaluate and fact-check AI-generated suggestions rather than accepting them automatically
  • Maintain ownership of your ideas, arguments, and final presentation

The key principle: Effective AI use requires thoughtful human participation. The AI Speech Coach will ask questions, help you explore possibilities, and offer feedback, but you remain responsible for the ideas and choices in your speech.

How to Use the AI Speech Coach

Step 1: Open the AI Speech Coach

Open the AI Speech Coach. The link will open the custom GPT in ChatGPT. If prompted, sign in using your CU Boulder ChatGPT account.

Step 2: Have a Conversation

Follow the opening instructions from the AI Speech Coach and respond to its questions. Treat the interaction as a conversation, rather than asking the AI to generate a speech for you.

The goal is for the AI to help you develop your thinking—not replace it. Explain your ideas, ask follow-up questions, add examples or experiences of your own, and tell the coach when a suggestion does or does not work for you.

Step 3: Evaluate the AI’s Suggestions

As you work, critically evaluate what the coach recommends. You are not required to accept every suggestion. Keep ideas that strengthen your speech, reject ideas that do not fit your purpose, and revise anything that does not sound like you.

You are also responsible for verifying any factual information, examples, statistics, quotations, or sources suggested by the AI.

Continue the coaching conversation until you have clarified your:

  • Topic and purpose
  • Story or stories
  • Main ideas
  • Use of logos, ethos, and pathos
  • Supporting evidence
  • Overall organization

Step 4 — Optional: Ask for a Consolidated Keyword Outline

When you have finished developing your ideas, you may ask the AI Speech Coach to create a consolidated outline based on the work you completed during the conversation.

For example:

“Please create a consolidated keyword outline of the speech we developed in this conversation.”

Revise anything in the outline that does not accurately represent your ideas or intended message.

Step 5: Submit Your AI Coaching Conversation

By the assignment deadline, paste either a link to your ChatGPT conversation or the full conversation into the Canvas submission box.

Part of your credit for this activity is based on active engagement with the AI coach. I am not looking for a particular number of prompts or a lengthy conversation. I am looking for evidence that you participated thoughtfully rather than simply giving brief answers and accepting whatever the AI suggested.

For example, active engagement might include:

  • Explaining or developing one of your ideas
  • Asking a follow-up question
  • Adding a personal example, story, or perspective
  • Choosing between possibilities and explaining your choice
  • Questioning or rejecting an AI suggestion
  • Revising an idea the AI proposed
  • Asking the coach to help you think through a problem or decision

In short: show me that you were doing some of the thinking.

Important: The submitted conversation must be from your CU Boulder ChatGPT account.
